DitherNoiseField.color: highlight adds a third colour for the peaks.
DitherNoiseField.highlight: highlight adds a third colour for the peaks.
DitherNoiseField.background: highlight adds a third colour for the peaks.
DitherNoiseField.scale: Size, folding and octaves of the noise.
DitherNoiseField.warp: Size, folding and octaves of the noise.
DitherNoiseField.detail: Size, folding and octaves of the noise.
DitherNoiseField.contrast: How hard the noise is cut into light and dark. Higher values give crisper edges.
DitherNoiseField.coverage: Shifts how much of the box is inked. Positive values fill more, negative values less.
DitherNoiseField.intensity: Overall brightness of the ink, 0 to 1.
DitherNoiseField.angle: Direction and speed of the drift.
DitherNoiseField.flow: Direction and speed of the drift.
